prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, shot on an iPhone with realistic handheld texture, fine natural film grain, true-to-life skin pores and no plastic AI sheen. Warm, soft natural daylight fills a real home dining table beside an everyday kitchen, matte skin with no oily facial glare. A high overhead shot looks straight down at the table, where a tired young Chinese office worker in her late twenties, still in a slightly rumpled work shirt, sits in front of a single bowl of plain hot noodles. The camera holds a static shot as she reaches for a plain unlabeled white ceramic jar, twists the lid off, and uses chopsticks to lift several dark-brown glossy strips of preserved mushroom out of the jar, laying them over the noodles and stirring them evenly into the bowl. [Shot 2] At 00:06.000, the shot transitions to an extreme close-up as the camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed on the chopsticks lifting a tangle of noodles; the dark-brown mushroom strips look oily and fragrant, the noodles are coated in glossy sauce, and light steam drifts upward. On-screen Chinese subtitle text reading "开罐即食，拌面更香" appears across the lower part of the frame in a warm white handwritten-style font. [Shot 3] At 00:11.000, the shot cuts to a medium close-up as the young woman lifts the noodles to her mouth and eats one bite, her tired expression softening into a relaxed, satisfied look. On-screen Chinese subtitle text reading "人间烟火，一罐就够" appears centered near the bottom of the frame in the same warm white handwritten-style font. No watermark or logo appears anywhere in the frame.

overall_soundscape: Quiet, cozy home-kitchen ambience with a faint refrigerator hum underneath. The ceramic lid twists off with a soft pop, chopsticks tap and scrape gently against the bowl, noodles are stirred and lifted with a light wet sound, and a soft, contented breath follows the first bite.

non_diegetic_music: A warm, gentle fingerpicked acoustic-guitar melody at a slow, relaxed tempo, with soft sustained notes that rise slightly in volume toward the end.

checks: 结构=指令(T2VA无对齐行)+integrated_multimodal_description/overall_soundscape/non_diegetic_music,顺序与字段名合规
时长15s三镜切点严格递增且落在时长内:Shot1(0)/Shot2(00:06.000)/Shot3(00:11.000)
运镜写法=类型+幅度+速度自然融入(static/push in small amplitude slow speed)
屏幕文字用英文双引号保留原中文原样:"开罐即食，拌面更香"、"人间烟火，一罐就够"
无对白故不设speaker ID;soundscape仅写环境/动作/非语言声,不与画面重复对白
去品牌:原文星满厨鹿茸菇改为unlabeled white ceramic jar + preserved mushroom,字幕不含品牌
去塑料感/去油光:realistic iPhone handheld/film grain/matte skin/no plastic sheen/soft diffused light
